Title: Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin
Body (HTML): Contemporary Australian dry gin from Healesville in the Yarra Valley. Whole oranges in the botanical basket give citrus pith and warmth rather than sweetness.
Product Category: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Beverages > Alcoholic Beverages > Liquor & Spirits > Gin
Image Alt Text: Four Pillars Rare Dry Gin 700 mL bottle
SEO Description: Contemporary Australian dry gin from the Yarra Valley. Delivered across Sydney metro.
Metafield: custom.why_we_stock_it [multi:
Cameron Mackenzie distils this in Healesville with whole Australian oranges in the botanical basket, which is why it tastes of citrus pith rather than citrus lolly.

It is the gin we reach for when someone says they do not like gin. Juniper is present but not shouting, and it holds its shape under tonic instead of disappearing.

The best $80 gin made in this country, and it is not particularly close.

Title: Penfolds Koonunga Hill Shiraz Cabernet
Body (HTML): South Australian Shiraz Cabernet blend. Dark fruit, soft chocolate note, tannins that carry the wine without dominating it.
Product Category: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Beverages > Alcoholic Beverages > Wine
Image Alt Text: Penfolds Koonunga Hill Shiraz Cabernet 750 mL bottle
SEO Description: South Australian Shiraz Cabernet. Delivered across Sydney metro.
Metafield: custom.why_we_stock_it [multi:
Koonunga Hill is the bottle that taught two generations of Australians what Shiraz Cabernet tastes like, and it has not been allowed to drift.

Dark fruit, a bit of chocolate, tannins that are present without being a chore. It does not need a decanter or an occasion.

Under twenty-five dollars and better than most things at twice the price.

Title: Curatif Negroni
Body (HTML): A full-strength Negroni canned in Melbourne. Equal parts, proper gin, bittersweet and dry.
Product Category: Food, Beverages & Tobacco > Beverages > Alcoholic Beverages > Pre-mixed Drinks
SEO Description: Full-strength canned Negroni made in Melbourne. Delivered across Sydney metro.
Metafield: custom.why_we_stock_it [multi:
Curatif bottle a genuine Negroni in Melbourne - equal parts, proper gin, no shortcuts - and can it at drinking strength rather than watering it down to look sessionable.

One can is one serve. Chill it, pour it over a big cube with an orange twist, and it is indistinguishable from a bar pour.

The only canned cocktail we stock that we would order in a bar.
